task_language: put the black bowl on top of the cabinet

subtasks.name: pick(black_bowl)
subtasks.outcome: failed: rim grasp at ~60-80 tilts the bowl, which falls back by 100; retries at ~120-140 and ~220-240 do not lift it

subtasks.name: place(black_bowl, cabinet_top, on)
subtasks.outcome: never attempted with the bowl: empty gripper goes to the cabinet top/handles from ~300

behaviour_summary: pi0 grasped the bowl rim and began lifting; the bowl tipped and slipped back (80-100). Two further approaches (~140, ~240) failed to pick it, then the empty gripper went over the cabinet and stayed there until timeout.

failures.mode_definition: The gripper closes on an object's rim or edge; when the lift starts the object tilts, slips out and falls back to the table.
failures.rl_success_check: black bowl lifted clear of the table (> 5 cm) and still in the closed gripper 1 s later
failures.observation: Step 40 open gripper above the bowl; 60 fingers at the rim; 80 bowl tilted and partly raised on one side; 100 bowl flat on the table again, gripper open above it. Retry at 120-140 (fingers above the bowl, no lift) and an angled approach at 220-240 also leave the bowl on the table.

failures.mode_definition: After a failed grasp the policy gives up on the object and moves to (and idles at) a destination-like location with an empty gripper instead of re-grasping.
hl_remedy: VERIFY(gripper empty, bowl on table, zoom)
INVOKE_RL(rl/pick_bowl) or REPROMPT('pick up the black bowl and place it on top of the cabinet')
failures.prevention: After each grasp attempt, VERIFY the object is in the gripper before allowing transport; count retries and INVOKE_RL after the first slip.
failures.observation: After the third failed approach (220-260) the gripper rises and moves over the cabinet (300-409), hovering empty near the top handle with the bowl still on the table.

notes: At 1 fps the retries at ~140 and ~240 may be aborted approaches rather than real closes; either way no lift. Similar to task10 init0: pick failure first, then empty-handed move to the destination.
